purpose.title: What is {{app}} for?
purpose.subtitle: Your answer tailors the next steps.

events.label: Events / broadcast
events.desc: Live shows to a wide audience, with chat and reactions.

meetings.label: 1:1 sessions / meetings
meetings.desc: Interactive rooms with a handful of participants.

live-shopping.label: Live shopping
live-shopping.desc: Sell live with reactions and a viewer count.

general.label: General use
general.desc: A bit of everything — decide later.

recording.title: Will you record?
recording.subtitle: You can change this any time.
recording.s3Hint: Recordings upload to this app's own S3 bucket, which you can configure later.

viewers.title: How many concurrent viewers?
viewers.subtitle: This tunes delivery for your audience size.
viewers.smallDesc: WebRTC with sub-second latency; single-layer keeps CPU low.
viewers.mediumDesc: Adaptive (simulcast) so each viewer gets a fitting quality.
viewers.largeDesc: Adaptive on — consider HLS delivery for very large audiences.

vision.title: Vision models
vision.subtitle: Install the analytics you need — their workers stay off until you start them.

occupancy.label: Occupancy
occupancy.desc: How many people are in view over time.

counting.label: Counting
counting.desc: Count people crossing a line (in / out).

lpr.label: License plates
lpr.desc: Read vehicle plates with allow / block lists.

tags.title: Tags
tags.subtitle: Label your streams (e.g. by store or zone). Optional.
tags.placeholder: Add a tag and press Enter

radio.title: Radio setup
radio.body: We'll create a passthrough ingress (RTMP → HLS remux, near-zero CPU) and install the radio player. You'll get the push URL and key on the final screen.

events.title: Event tools
events.body: We'll enable chat, reactions and the live viewer count, and install the quality selector overlay.

live-shopping.title: Live-shopping tools
live-shopping.body: We'll enable reactions and the live viewer count so your audience can react as you sell.

meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.body: Meetings run in interactive rooms — no extra setup needed here.

summary.title: Review
summary.subtitle: These changes will be applied to {{app}}.
summary.empty: No changes to apply — you can finish now and set things up later.

actions.features: Enable chat, reactions and the viewer count

banner.title: Finish setting up {{app}}
banner.body: Run the setup wizard to tailor recording, delivery and analytics for this app.
